Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of a compound of G4314 and G5315; something eaten in addition to bread, i.e. a relish (specially, fish; compare G3795):--meat.
BiblicalUsage: Prosphagion means something eaten with bread, a relish, meat or fish. It appears once, on the shore after the resurrection: Jesus saith unto them, Children, have ye any meat?
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the risen Lord's first question to His tired disciples is about breakfast, because He feeds His people before He commissions them.
